'''1997 Sullust Regionals Gaetano Ferrara DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaetano Ferrara]]
* '''Event:''' [[1997 Sullust Regionals]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Star Destroyer: Launch Bay]]
* '''Strategy:''' Star Destroyer: Launch Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Star Destroyer Launch Bay Ferrara.txt |Download]]
Decipher published this file as the Sullust Regional Dark list; the printed character and starship lines match the Light file.
